# eval-run-ledger

> Append-only JSONL ledger of evaluation runs: duration from an injected clock, case count, tokens and Decimal cost per run, with a summary CLI Python package `trysac-eval-run-ledger`, import name `eval_run_ledger`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
